service: lr1-service

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: python3.9
  stage: ${opt:stage, 'dev'}
  region: ${opt:region, 'us-east-1'}
  environment:
    PYTHON_ENV: ${self:provider.stage}
  iamRoleStatements:
    - Effect: Allow
      Action:
        - logs:CreateLogGroup
        - logs:CreateLogStream
        - logs:PutLogEvents
      Resource: "arn:aws:logs:*:*:*"

functions:
  # Servicio 1: FIRST Table
  first-table:
    handler: src/handlers/handler.lambda_handler
    name: ${self:service}-${self:provider.stage}-first-table
    description: Calcula tabla FIRST para gramáticas
    events:
      - http:
          path: /first-table
          method: post
          cors: true
    environment:
      SERVICE_NAME: ${self:service}
      STAGE: ${self:provider.stage}

  # Servicio 2: LR(1) Closure Table
  lr1-closure:
    handler: src/handlers/handler_lr1_closure.lambda_handler
    name: ${self:service}-${self:provider.stage}-lr1-closure
    description: Genera conjuntos de elementos LR(1) con cierres
    events:
      - http:
          path: /lr1-closure
          method: post
          cors: true
    environment:
      SERVICE_NAME: ${self:service}
      STAGE: ${self:provider.stage}

  # Servicio 3: LR(1) Table (ACTION/GOTO)
  lr1-table:
    handler: src/handlers/handler_table_LR1.lambda_handler
    name: ${self:service}-${self:provider.stage}-lr1-table
    description: Genera tabla ACTION/GOTO para LR(1)
    events:
      - http:
          path: /lr1-table
          method: post
          cors: true
    environment:
      SERVICE_NAME: ${self:service}
      STAGE: ${self:provider.stage}

  # Servicio 4: LR(1) Trace
  lr1-trace:
    handler: src/handlers/handler_lr1_trace.lambda_handler
    name: ${self:service}-${self:provider.stage}-lr1-trace
    description: Simula parsing LR(1) y genera trace
    events:
      - http:
          path: /lr1-trace
          method: post
          cors: true
    environment:
      SERVICE_NAME: ${self:service}
      STAGE: ${self:provider.stage}

  # Servicio 5: Pipeline completo (opcional)
  lr1-pipeline:
    handler: src/handlers/handler_pipeline.lambda_handler
    name: ${self:service}-${self:provider.stage}-lr1-pipeline
    description: Pipeline completo LR(1) desde gramática hasta trace
    events:
      - http:
          path: /lr1-pipeline
          method: post
          cors: true
    environment:
      SERVICE_NAME: ${self:service}
      STAGE: ${self:provider.stage}

# plugins:
#   - serverless-python-requirements

# custom:
#   pythonRequirements:
#     dockerizePip: false
#     slim: true
#     strip: false

package:
  include:
    - src/**
  exclude:
    - .git/**
    - .env*
    - README.md
    - __pycache__/**
    - "*.pyc"
    - node_modules/**
    - .pytest_cache/**
    - "*.egg-info/**"
